| **Date** | **Event** | **Details / Significance** |

| **May 20, 2017** | New Supports Installed | First appearance of new wood and steel supports on the original Hurler structure. |
| **May 21, 2017** | First Teaser Post | Park tweets the first in a series of teasers, setting the ride’s announcement date for **August 16, 2017**. |
| **August 8, 2017** | Lift Hill Topped Off | The ride’s highest point (lift hill) was officially "topped off" — a major milestone signaling progress. |
| **August 16, 2017** | Official Announcement | Kings Dominion confirms *Hurler will reopen as Twisted Timbers* in 2018. Press release includes promotional artwork and ride specs. |
| **February 17, 2018** | Final Track & Trains Installed | Final track pieces and two custom trains are installed. Park employees sign the final piece as an "Easter egg." |
| **February 21, 2018** | First Ride Test | Park conducts the first full test of the completed ride. |
| **March 20, 2018** | Train Test (Pre-Opening) | The two trains (blue and green) test together four days before the grand opening. |
| **March 22–23, 2018** | Soft Openings | Scheduled for March 22 (media & American Coaster Enthusiasts), but delayed due to inclement weather. Both held on **March 23**. |
